scope: Published Gaia EDR3 observer-acceleration compressed subchannel

primary.title: Gaia Early Data Release 3: Acceleration of the Solar System from Gaia astrometry
primary.author: Gaia Collaboration, Klioner et al.
primary.retrieval: Exa web_fetch_exa fetched article, Table2 HTML and PDF text; direct HTTP and web open returned403. PDF text supplies correlation labels absent from HTML extraction.
primary.exact_upstream_bytes: A&A bytes unavailable; arXiv PDF retrieved separately and bound below; scientific source identity is published A&A table
primary.source_selection: 1,215,942 five-parameter Gaia-CRF3 QSO-like sources; external QSO/AGN cross-match and astrometric filtering; six-parameter sources excluded
primary.fit: Simultaneous spheroidal and toroidal VSH through lmax=3; robust source-level clipping kappa=3, about3800 rejected
primary.coordinate_frame: Equatorial ICRS; catalogue astrometry referenced to solar-system barycentre
primary.uncertainty_method: Bootstrap uncertainties; 1.05-1.08 times fit uncertainties already scaled by unit-weight error~1.048. These are not uninflated inverse-normal uncertainties.
primary.inter_source_covariance: Explicitly unmodeled in arXivv1 Sect5; not measured zero
primary.systematics_status: Published tests support observer-acceleration interpretation; not a released joint spatial/calibration/selection covariance or guaranteed bound
primary.first_order_fractional_accuracy: arXivv1 Sect2 estimates about1e-4 for the source astrometric setting; no new cosmic optical remainder bound inferred

arxiv_pdf_readback.visual_check: Rendered and inspected Table2: labels and numbers agree with published A&A extraction

primary.section_numbering: Section pointers follow locally retained arXiv2012.02036v1 PDF; published A&A HTML has different section numbering.

legacy.reuse_decision: Read legacy full-Gaia +713radio result; no catalogue redownload or refit. New work imports published bootstrap acceleration vector/correlations and evaluates its physical observer response, prediction covariance and confounding.
legacy.comparability: Same Gaia astrometry and overlapping sample: dependent analyses, not independent measurements; sample, clipping and lmax differ. No combined chi-square or difference significance.

freshness.title: The Gaia Astrometric Catalogue and Secular Aberration Drift in Proper Motions
freshness.finding: Gaia catalogue defined in BCRS with spatial axes aligned with ICRS; acceleration contribution in PM does not require correcting catalogue or redefining frame. Transforming to Galactic/distant rest observer is scientific modeling.

freshness.title: Observing the peculiar acceleration of our Solar System with quasar proper motions
freshness.retrieval: Web open v3; Exa abs URL incorrectly returned v1 content and must not be used for current numeric values
freshness.method: Model2: deterministic VSH l<=3 plus isotropic stochastic high-multipole power l=4..10, pixel covariance and mask matched SBI; marginal coverage checked on500 simulations restricted to inner90% of prior
freshness.finding: Spatial/high-multipole nuisance uncertainty materially wider than source bootstrap, especially masked4-5times. Marginal intervals and corner plots do not supply joint3x3 covariance or reusable likelihood; no numerical covariance invented. Same Gaia astrometry, not independent measurement.
freshness.availability: No posterior-sample download or analysis-code URL identified in inspected paper; this is not an exhaustive external repository search.
